steps.name: format-focus-changed-files
steps.command: git status --short --branch && cd frontend && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write src/components/map/pinned-media/PinnedMediaDrawer.tsx src/styles/pinned-media.css e2e/visual/discovery-drawer.spec.ts && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --check src/components/map/pinned-media/PinnedMediaDrawer.tsx src/styles/pinned-media.css e2e/visual/discovery-drawer.spec.ts

steps.name: typecheck-lint-unit-build
steps.command: cd frontend && npm run lint && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/components/map/pinned-media/pinnedMediaDrawerStage.test.ts && npm run build

steps.name: single-worker-chrome-regression
steps.command: cd frontend && E2E_CHROME_EXECUTABLE='/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome' ../scripts/quality/e2e.sh e2e/visual/discovery-drawer.spec.ts e2e/visual/pinned-media-drawer.spec.ts --workers=1
